title: Where the name Trona comes from
text: The name Trona is derived from the mineral trona, which is abundant in Searles Lake. Searles Valley includes the unincorporated communities of Argus, Pioneer Point, Searles Valley, and Trona. The 2020 census counted 1,565 people.
